name: Garrett Borton
prior_offices: Weston County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Garrett Borton is a Weston County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists him on the board. The News Letter Journal reported that he led the August 2026 Republican primary field with 1,227 votes.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
